content: R hex sticker conventions: standard hex size 181x209 px PNG, SVG preferred for scalability, print 2in x 1.73in. hexSticker::sticker() generates either format via filename extension. Source script in inst/logo/logo.R. Output placed at man/figures/logo.png (CRAN-safe location). usethis::use_logo() places the logo at man/figures/logo.png, generates README markdown img tag, adds pkgdown/ to .Rbuildignore. pkgdown auto-discovers man/figures/logo.png for navbar. pkgdown/favicon/ (generated by build_favicons) goes in .Rbuildignore. man/figures/logo.png DOES end up in the CRAN tarball but is small and CRAN-acceptable. Large image files like print-quality stickers should go in tools/ or inst/logo/ not man/figures/.
